August, 2023

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc-Lko:54996
Court No. - 14
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 10348 of 2023
Applicant :- Mohd Asif

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru Prin. Secy. Home Govt. Of U.P. Lko And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Mohd. Suhail,Ali Hasan
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Mohammad Alishah Faruqi
Hon'ble Mohd. Faiz Alam Khan,J.
1.
Counter affidavit filed by the informant/complainant is taken on record.
2. Learned A.G.A. informs that he has procured complete instructions in the matter including upto date case diary of the case.

3. Heard Shri Mohd. Suhail, learned counsel for the accused-applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State, Shri Mohammad Alishah Faruqi, learned counsel appearing for the informant/complainant and perused the record.
4.

This bail application has been moved by the accused/applicant- Mohd Asif for grant of bail, in Case Crime No.148 of 2023, under Sections 452, 376, 506 I.P.C. & 3/4 of the P.O.C.S.O. Act and 67 of the I.T. Act, Police Station Kotwali Rudauli, District Ayodhya, during trial.

sentences.text: 5. Learned counsel for the accused-applicant while pressing the bail application submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in this case and he has not committed any offence as claimed by the prosecution.

6. It is further submitted that F.I.R. of this case has been lodged by the prosecutrix herself, wherein allegation of molestation as well as clicking obscene photographs and making obscene video and of blackmailing the victim on the basis of same and also allegations of committing sexual assault has been levelled against the applicant.

In her statement recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C.
the victim has fortified the allegation as levelled in the F.I.R.
7.

It is further submitted that in her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., the prosecutrix had admitted that she was in a relationship with the applicant, however, the applicant was blackmailing her on the basis of making her obscene video viral and was also by posting irrelevant and obscene material on the social platforms.

8. It is further submitted that since the relation of the applicant with the victim has been admitted, it appears to be a case of consent, however, the allegations as levelled in the statement of prosecutrix did not find corroboration with the medical evidence as she refused to undergo internal medical examination and in support of allegation of sexual assault, there is only and only oral statement of the prosecutrix/victim, which are not corroborated by any medical evidence.

9. It is also submitted that now the matter has been settled between the applicant and victim and in fact the F.I.R. was lodged on the basis that there had been quarrel between the applicant and informant/victim as well as between their family members.

While drawing attention of this Court towards various paragraphs of the counter affidavit filed by the opposite party no.2/victim, today, it vehemently submitted that it is admitted to the informant/victim that allegation of sexual assault has been levelled in her statements recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. under the pressure of her family members and in fact no such incident had occurred.

10. It is next submitted that applicant is in jail in this case since 29.05.2023 and he is not having any criminal history, charge-sheet in this case has already been submitted and there is no apprehension that after being released on bail the applicant may flee from the course of law or may otherwise misuse the liberty.
11.

Learned A.G.A., however, opposes the prayer of bail of the applicant on the ground that the applicant has committed an heinous offence and having regard to the material/evidence available against the applicant, he is not entitled to be released on bail, but could not controvert the other factual submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant.
12.

Shri Mohammad Alishah Faruqi, learned counsel appearing for the informant/complainant while referring to the counter affidavit filed by the opposite party no.2/victim submits that under the instructions of the opposite party no.2 he is not opposing the plea of bail of the applicant and he has been instructed to make a statement before this Court that the facility of bail may kindly be extended to the applicant.

sentences.text: While referring to the paragraph nos.3 to 6 of the counter affidavit, it is further submitted that the statements of the victim recorded under Sections 161 and 164 were given by the opposite party no.2/victim under the pressure and tuition of her parents and she still wants to marry the applicant and also that the sexual relations between the applicant and informant/opposite party no.2 were also established with her free wish, will and consent and now the applicant and opposite party no.2 have agreed to solemnize marriage, further detention of the applicant would ruin their future matrimonial prospects, thus facility of bail may be extended to the applicant.

It is also submitted that at the relevant date and time of the incident, the prosecutrix, as per her educational credentials,
was aged about 17 years and 7 months, thus she was having sufficient intellect to understand the consequences of her act.

14. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the record, it is evident that though the F.I.R. has been lodged by the opposite party no.2/victim herself and statements were also given by her under Sections 161 and 164 alleging sexual assault and various other allegations have also been levelled against the applicant, however, in the counter affidavit filed by the victim filed today it is categorically stated that a settlement has taken place between the parties and they have agreed to solemnize marriage.

The statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Sections 164 Cr.P.C. would also indicate that it is admitted to the prosecutrix/victim that she was in a relationship with the applicant, which has been admitted by her in categorical terms in various paragraphs of the counter affidavit filed today.
She also stated in the counter affidavit that sexual relations were made by her with her free consent.

Thus having regard to the fact that the prosecutrix is not having any objection, if the facility of bail is extended to the applicant and also keeping in view the fact that at the relevant point of time, she was aged about 17 years and 7 months and was having sufficient intellect to understand her welfare and sexual relations are admitted to have taken place with her consent and also keeping in view the settlement arrived at between the parties, the facility of bail, in the considered opinion of this Court, may be extended to the applicant.
Charge-sheet in this case has already been filed.
Applicant is in jail in this case since 29.05.2023 without any previous criminal history.
The presence of the applicant may be secured before the trial court by placing adequate conditions.

15. Having regard to the overall facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the nature of the offence, evidence, complicity of the accused, severity of punishment, submissions of the learned counsel for the parties and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I am of the considered view that applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is thus allowed.

16. Let the accused/applicant- Mohd Asif involved in above-mentioned case, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
(ii) The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
17. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.

18. Identity, status and residence proof of the applicant and sureties be verified by the Court concerned before the bonds are accepted.
19.
Observations made herein-above by this court are only for the purpose of disposal of this bail application and shall not be construed as an expression of this Court on the merits of the case.
